t.why: Its sharp turn in security policy draws wide attention in Latin America. It made bitcoin legal tender in 2021, then dropped mandatory acceptance in 2025.
t.rel: A hard-line crackdown on gangs has transformed security. In cooperation with the United States, it has even taken people deported from the United States into its own prisons.
t.know: It went through 12 years of civil war that ended in 1992.
t.etext: Garment assembly and remittances from the United States are a big part of the economy. It made bitcoin legal tender in 2021, then removed that status under the terms of IMF support.
